name: controlzebra-website
description: ControlZebra marketing website built with Astro

scripts.pages:dev: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.validate: npm run docs:guard && npm run build && npm run check
scripts.pages:deploy: npm run build && npm run docs:guard && wrangler pages deploy dist
scripts.deploy:worker-assets: npm run build && npm run docs:guard && wrangler deploy --dry-run
